profile_text: Funeral planning and insurance services are driving growth in Germany, with a 115.0% increase in employees since the baseline, indicating a strong demand for end-of-life planning solutions. As a provider of these services, this company has successfully scaled its operations to meet the needs of its customers, employing 43 people in 2024. With a focus on pre-arranged funeral services, the company is capitalizing on the trend towards planned and insured funeral arrangements.
